question: Can a provider-defined cohida universe, identity mapping, immutable snapshot, and source/as-of contract be verified for read-only research intake?
decision_boundary: No downstream normalization, replay, shadow, promotion, or live activity may start unless membership and mapping pass the source contract.

utc_window.basis: rerun declaration; snapshot itself taken at 2026-09-23T03:08:34Z

source.provider_timezone: UTC (database session; timestamp without time zone)

selected_universe.quote_base_conventions: Coinbase product ID format BASE-QUOTE (e.g. BTC-USD); multi-quote pairs present (USD, USDC, USDT, EUR, GBP, BTC, ETH, INR, AUD, BRL, CAD, SGD)
selected_universe.note: The stored `symbol` column IS the Coinbase product ID directly; there is no separate provider-native-ID-to-symbol mapping table to hash. membership_sha256 is the canonical hash of the sorted, deduplicated symbol list actually observed in cohida-db-prod across all five granularity tables.

schema.schema_scope: structural schema plus row-level DISTINCT symbol aggregate (no raw OHLCV row extract)

freshness_and_asof_policy.policy: Fresh if the latest bar (any granularity) is within 30h of now (24h daily-retrieval cycle + 6h buffer). Beyond 30h, treat as a failed/missed run and fail-closed rather than compute against stale candles. All five granularities are refreshed together in one daily 00:00 UTC pass (scripts/retrieve-production.sh), so this is a single threshold, not per-granularity SLAs.
freshness_and_asof_policy.known_incident: Filed on the cohida board as t_ea0061f4 (~92h staleness, ~4 missed daily cycles) for operational investigation; not resolved by this manifest.

revision_and_correction_policy.policy: NOT append-only. Verified in cpp-cohida/src/database/DatabaseManager.cpp: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (symbol, timestamp) DO UPDATE overwrites open_price/high_price/low_price/close_price/volume/updated_at in place on every re-retrieval. No history of the prior value is retained.
revision_and_correction_policy.revision_signal: updated_at > created_at indicates at least one revision since first ingestion; created_at is a DB default set once and never touched by the UPDATE SET clause.
revision_and_correction_policy.consequence_for_downstream: (symbol, timestamp) is not a stable read key across time. P2 and any reproducible computation must snapshot the exact row values used at computation time rather than re-derive by (symbol, timestamp) lookup later.

authoritative_inputs.path: prior P1 evidence: t_25ac3ce2 evidence_id 3097916558cfb08075849712a371cd25c9d197bccc5553f68a740549382b3027 (superseded by this rerun)

transformations: Started cohida-db-prod against its existing production data volume (no schema/data writes) per explicit user authorization.
Ran read-only SELECT DISTINCT symbol UNION across crypto_300, crypto_900, crypto_3600, crypto_21600, crypto_86400 (the bare crypto table is unused/empty).
Ran read-only min/max(timestamp) against crypto_300 to establish observed coverage window and staleness.
Canonicalized the sorted, deduplicated symbol list and computed its sha256 as membership_sha256.
Read cpp-cohida/src/database/DatabaseManager.cpp directly to verify (not assume) the revision/correction policy.
No row-level OHLCV extraction, no joins, no proxy symbols, no zero filling, no outcome calculations.
rerun_template: ./scripts/cohida/freeze_universe_snapshot.sh --host <cohida-db-host> --port <port> --db unordered_map --user <readonly-user> --schema priority_queue > contracts/cohida/universe_snapshot_v2.json; diff against v1 to detect membership drift; recompute this evidence_id from the recorded idempotency_key.
limitations: Universe membership reflects what has been ingested as of 2026-09-23T03:08:34Z; per the revision policy above, individual bar values (not membership) may still change in place on future re-retrieval.
No raw OHLCV row extract, quote/book, fee, fill, or mark data were extracted -- membership and coverage-window aggregates only.
The known ~92h staleness incident (t_ea0061f4) means the most recent ~4 daily cycles' worth of new listings or delistings, if any, are not reflected in this snapshot.
Cross-universe reconciliation against the market-reference dataset (SPY/QQQ/etc.) remains REJECTED as in the prior P1 run -- different provider, different asset class, no proxying is permitted.
